quest_version_id.immutability: same id through review/approval/publish for this content version; new content version gets new id

objective_id.created_when: after teacher approves and backend persists the LO

item_id.created_when: backend registers assessment item for the quest version

activity_id.owner: content activity identity in Story Bundle; runtime binding reviewed by PIC D

evidence_id.owner: narrative evidence artifact; not item_id and not source_map_id

substitution_rule: In an isolated fixture run, fixture aliases may be seeded only in a clearly marked test namespace. For staging/production, backend must assign or resolve its persistent IDs and materialize QuestV1/private assessment references consistently before publish.
